title: R2. Two-form route obligation
milestone_description: There is a real c>0 such that, for every sufficiently large natural n, there exist integers b1,a1,b2,a2 with b1*a2 != b2*a1 and both |bi+ai Re(riemannZeta(9))| < exp(-c n). The determinant condition requires independent integer coefficient pairs. No coefficient-height or prescribed-lattice condition occurs in the published statement. Its unrestricted existence formulation must be distinguished from constructing the actual weighted-lattice outputs with the required arithmetic and analytic controls; it is not claimed to be strictly stronger than the irrationality goal.
